english.note: This is the everyday all-purpose choice for saying that someone or something also does or has something.
This is the all-purpose spoken choice for expressing “likewise” or “also,” including “me too.”
This is the all-purpose choice, especially when “either” means “also” after a negative statement.
Use 都 as the everyday choice for “also” or “too” before the verb or predicate.

examples.english: I also want to go eat.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dou1 soeng2 heoi3 sik6 faan6

examples.english: I don't eat spicy food, and you don't either.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 m4 sik6 laat6 nei5 dou1 m4 sik6 laat6
